title: Coordinate space representation for quantum simulation of scalar field theory
summary: Quantum computing provides a promising framework for the simulation of quantum field theories, where the computational cost depends both on the quantum algorithm employed and on the representation of the Hamiltonian. We investigate a formulation of the $φ^4$ model based on the harmonic-oscillator basis in coordinate space. We derive the lattice $φ^4$ Hamiltonian in this representation and analyze the structure of the resulting one-body matrix and interaction tensor.
